title: AbbVie pens $1.4B deal for deprioritized IBD drug from Nxera
summary: AbbVie has added another angle to its relationship with Nxera, with the Big Pharma paying $100 million upfront for a phase 1 inflammatory bowel disease candidate.

title: Ultragenyx shrinks workforce and axes assets to halve R&D spend
summary: Ultragenyx is laying off 20% of its workforce and axing drug development programs to cut its annual R&D budget to half of the amount it spent in 2025.

title: Sanofi scraps STAT6 degrader from Nurix just 2 months after entering clinic
summary: Sanofi has decided to end work on a STAT6 degrader from Nurix just two months after taking the inflammatory disease drug into the clinic.

title: Novo’s CEO still looking for deals to ‘close some of the gaps,’ as misfires hit profits

title: AbbVie invests £120M in UK, including new R&D headquarters

title: Philips sets aside $322M for proposed DOJ settlement over sleep apnea device recall
summary: Philips’ Respironics division has reached an “agreement in principle” with the U.S. Department of Justice to settle a long-running investigation into its recall of potentially defective sleep apnea devices.

title: Rhythm doubles down on LG obesity license, raising payout to as much as $855M
summary: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals and LG Chem have rewritten the terms of their licensing agreement for the oral obesity and hyperphagia drug bivamelagon, growing to $855 million in scheduled payments from the earlier milestone-based deal of $305 million.

title: AbbVie abandons phase 2 solid tumor drug over ‘limited benefit’
summary: AbbVie has scrapped a phase 2 solid tumor drug after deciding that the monoclonal antibody was unlikely to best the current standard of care, Fierce has learned.

title: Pfizer pares back obesity pipeline, drops phase 2-stage lung disease candidate
summary: Pfizer has axed a phase 2 pulmonary arterial hypertension program on business grounds, dealing a setback to a long-running effort to treat the lung disease by targeting BMP9.

title: Abbott's Tectonic test looks to shift artery disease treatment with ‘early’ win

title: BioArctic left out in the cold as Novartis walks away from $800M neuro collab

title: Karyopharm files Chapter 11, lines up Ayrmid as lead bidder in planned merger
summary: In an answer to Karyopharm's cash crisis, Irish biotech Ayrmid has agreed to make the first bid on the struggling biopharma's assets in a court supervised auction, teeing up a potential hematology merger.

title: OpenAI-funded Biossil snags Theriva's unwanted antibiotic degrader portfolio for up to $91M

title: When drug development gets personal
